kernelbench-cuda-megaqwen-decode::rtx-pr.note: Identity, version guard fields (schema_version 1, RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation, sm_120a, 96 GB, four-problem deck incl. 03_megaqwen_decode) and the decode-only 2k–128k/prefill-untimed description all match leaderboard.json and SPEC.md, and the lifecycle fields check out (no retirement/supersession text; runs published through 2026-09-22 support status active; superseded_by null consistent with no successor named). But the claimed metric/unit ('Peak fraction of the problem's hardware roofline ... rendered as % of roofline', unit 'percent of roofline') contradicts the current protocol text: SPEC.md (last updated 2026-07-16) states problem 03's score is 'decode-only tok/s at ctx ∈ {2k,8k,32k,128k}', not a roofline fraction, and its latency-anchored rule names 02 (not 03) — the row's notes misattribute ms-headline to the decode problem. The row's metric field cannot be reconciled with the SPEC's stated metric for this problem, so c1 fails; c2 itself is supported by the same sources.
